title: Coffee Sales Dashboard
description: An interactive dashboard tracking coffee sales across roast types, sizes, and countries.
details:
This dashboard tracks coffee sales performance across roast type, size, and region.

Filters cover order date, roast type (dark, light, medium), size (0.2kg to 2.5kg), and loyalty card status, so the view can be narrowed to any segment.

The main views cover total sales over time by variety (Arabica, Excelsa, Liberica, Robusta), sales by country, and the top 5 customers by revenue.

title: Bike Sales Dashboard
description: This interactive Bike Sales Dashboard analyzes customer demographics and purchasing behavior to uncover key drivers behind sales. It highlights that the primary buyers are middle-aged, higher-income individuals with short daily commutes under one mile.
details: This Bike Sales Dashboard is an interactive data visualization project designed to analyze customer demographics and purchasing behavior to identify key drivers behind bike sales. By examining income levels, age brackets, and commute distances alongside interactive filters for marital status, region, and education, the dashboard reveals that the primary target customer is a middle-aged, higher-income individual with a short daily commute of under one mile.

title: Velmora Sales Analysis & Dashboard
description: Membersihkan dan menganalisis data penjualan setahun dengan Python, lalu memvisualisasikannya jadi dashboard interaktif di Power BI untuk perusahaan retail fiksional Velmora.
details:
Assessment Data Analyst dari Intern2Grow: membersihkan data penjualan mentah dengan Python/Pandas, menjawab 7 pertanyaan bisnis, lalu membangun dashboard Power BI untuk memvisualisasikan hasilnya.

Proses cleaning mencakup perbaikan typo pada nama kategori (Clohting → Clothing, Bgas → Bags, Shoeses → Shoes), normalisasi whitespace, pengisian nilai kosong, dan penghapusan data duplikat.

Hasil analisis: total revenue setahun $759.130, dengan Smartphone sebagai produk dengan revenue tertinggi ($434.400) dan Electronics sebagai kategori dengan revenue tertinggi ($516.080). Rata-rata harga produk $211,03, dengan total 5.341 unit terjual dan rata-rata revenue $2.062,85 per transaksi.

Dashboard Power BI menampilkan temuan ini secara visual: empat KPI utama di bagian atas, breakdown revenue per kategori dan produk, serta distribusi revenue per kuartal yang menunjukkan performa relatif merata sepanjang tahun (sekitar 24-26% per kuartal).
